waypoints.name: Dawson City

waypoints.name: Top of the World summit
waypoints.advice: Top of the World summit comes up 97 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Poker Creek border, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Dawson City → Top of the World summit climbs about 1376 m in 65 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.

scenicChapters.title: Dawson City → Top of the World summit
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 132 km. 1376 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Top of the World Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 62 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

top-of-the-world-highway-dawson-city-pok.story: A one-way ride of 194 km, Dawson City to the finish - roughly 2 h 40 in the saddle. The highest point is about 1,400 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
